mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: a 2024 King main bearing found out of spec on the free-spread dimension, with a 2025 main reportedly showing the same issue and a specialist advising against using them. Next production quoted as January 2027.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: King STDX thrust bearings reported as over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, i.e. a dimensional defect rather than an install error.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received a sealed King XP main and rod set with the wrong shell configuration, and reports being redirected to the supplier instead of getting help from King. Complaint is about service handling as much as the part.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: One shell in a King SI bi-metal main set reported crushed and twisted from production and unusable, plus machining shavings and oil found inside the shrink wrap of the rod bearings.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no official King representative has responded and it remains open and unresolved.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is---King Bearings are no longer an option....
mentions.snippet: Builders writing King off for DSM applications, citing 6-bolt sets on indefinite back-order since Covid and availability dates repeatedly pushed back. Supply frustration rather than a defect report.
